question: How much will Nvidia's stock price returns exceed Microsoft's in these biweekly periods of Q4 2026? (Nov 9 - Nov 20)

calls.reasoning: Window: P0=Nov 6 close, P1=Nov 20 close (10 trading days), and it contains NVDA's Q3 FY27 earnings (Nov 17 after the close, reaction Nov 18). The regime is extreme: MSFT +6.6% while NVDA -3.1% on Nov 4; NVDA -9.3% on Nov 5 (SOX -12%) on election/AI-regulation fears; NVDA rebounded ~4-5.6% on Nov 6. Reference class: NVDA-MSFT 2-week return differences, historically centered near 0-1pp with SD ~5-6pp, roughly doubled now by realized vol plus earnings. Median kept near 0 with a slight positive tilt (oversold rebound and an expected beat vs a rotation into AI spenders like MSFT). Fat tails priced as ~7% escape mass on each side. No matching human market found: Manifold's candidate is Big Tech vs Bitcoin over the 2020s (unrelated); Polymarket has only NVDA price-level and earnings-beat contracts.

calls.reconciliation: All three runs agree on the window, the earnings date (Nov 17 after the close, with the reaction inside the window either way, so the MarketBeat Nov 18 listing doesn't matter) and a median near zero. The MSFT price-level inconsistency with the background's -21% YTD can't be settled without web access. It doesn't affect a return differential. Elevated realized vol will probably partly mean-revert over two weeks, but the earnings event is certain to land in the window. On that basis I take an SD of ~8.5-9pp with 5% escape mass on each side, which is close to Runs 1 and 2. The median is +0.3 because the directional arguments roughly cancel.
